text: ぼうそうぞく　でて　いったの？

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-form verb shows the action moving away from here. でて　いった = 'went out and away', 'left'.

patterns.name: 〜の (question)
patterns.explanation: の at the end with a rising voice makes a soft, casual question. いったの？ = 'did they go?'.
